product_family: Flourish is a no-code data visualization and interactive storytelling platform owned by Canva. Core products: interactive charts, maps, scrollytelling experiences, and live-updating data visualizations. Serves newsrooms, financial services, marketing, nonprofits, and educational institutions.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Flourish is certified to the internationally recognized info-security standard ISO27001 by the British Standards Institute.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Not mentioned on Flourish's security page, DPA, or privacy policy. Parent company Canva holds SOC 2 Type II, but Flourish product does not explicitly claim this certification on its own vendor domain.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: transferring the Customer Personal Data to a recipient that has executed Module 3 (processor-to-processor transfers) of the SCCs and UK Addendum with Flourish.
certifications.source: https://flourish.studio/dpa/ (DPA incorporates GDPR and UK GDPR definitions; personal data primarily stored in the EEA in Dublin, Ireland per https://flourish.studio/security/)

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of HIPAA compliance on Flourish pages. Third-party sources explicitly state Canva/Flourish should not be used for PHI (Protected Health Information) without a BAA, and no BAA is offered.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of PCI DSS certification on Flourish's security or compliance pages. Not mentioned in DPA or public documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy policy mentions 'analyzing prompts and results to provide and enhance AI tools such as AI Assistant' but does not explicitly confirm whether customer visualization data or interactions are used to train AI models. Canva's AI Product Terms reference this but details are not provided in public Flourish documentation. Requires direct contact for clarity.
privacy.data_region: European Economic Area (EEA), primarily Dublin, Ireland (AWS-hosted). May transfer outside EEA with Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and UK Addendum for lawful processing.

security.name: Data center
security.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS), primarily Dublin, Ireland region (EEA)

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Conducted at least yearly (white-box and black-box methods)

security.name: Bug bounty program
security.value: BugCrowd partnership for continuous crowdsourced security testing

security.name: Code review
security.value: Peer review with automated and manual security testing before release

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Least privilege principle; only necessary personnel access customer data

security.name: Multi-factor authentication
security.value: 2FA available for all users; 2FA enforcement available for enterprise accounts

security.name: Sub-processor notification
security.value: Updated list maintained; customers notified at least 14 days before new sub-processors engaged. Customers may object within 14 days; non-resolution may trigger service termination with refund.

products.name: Interactive Charts & Maps
products.notes: Core product for creating static and interactive charts, maps, and data visualizations. No AI training claims specific to this product.

products.name: Scrollytelling
products.data_scope: User content (text, images, data, narrative structure)
products.notes: No-code scrollytelling experience builder. Data handling same as core platform.

products.name: Live-Updating Data Visualization
products.notes: Visualizations that update in real-time from data sources. Subject to same security and GDPR commitments.

products.name: AI Assistant (nascent)
products.notes: Referenced in privacy policy as under development. AI training practices on customer data are unclear; not explicitly detailed in public documentation.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free tier with limitations) + paid subscription tiers (Starter, Professional, Team, Enterprise)
compare.data_residency: EEA primary (Dublin, Ireland). International transfers governed by SCCs and UK Addendum. No private/on-premise deployment option.

flags: AI training posture unclear: Privacy policy mentions 'analyzing prompts and results' for AI enhancement but does not explicitly confirm whether customer visualization data or interactions train models. Clarification needed.

SOC 2 not held by Flourish: While parent company Canva holds SOC 2 Type II, Flourish's own security page and DPA do not claim SOC 2 certification. Vendors should not imply Flourish is SOC 2 certified unless explicitly stated on flourish.studio domain.
HIPAA not supported: Flourish is not suitable for Protected Health Information (PHI). No BAA offered. Explicitly not HIPAA compliant.
Trust center: Flourish does not maintain a dedicated trust center on flourish.studio; relies on Canva's trust.canva.com. May impact vendor's independent security posture perception.
